source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of graph properties (PDF 113-114).

blocks.text: Graph ki kuch aur tafseelat bhi hain jo us ki banawat batati hain:

items: Degree: kisi vertex se judi edges ki tadaad. Maslan agar ek shehar teen shehron se jura ho to us vertex ki degree 3 hai.
Weight (wazan): kuch graphs mein edges par values hoti hain, jaise faasla ya kharcha (cost). Maslan do shehron ke darmiyan sarak 50 kilometre lambi ho to us edge ka weight 50 ho sakta hai.

Direction (simt): edges directed ya undirected hoti hain. Directed edge ek taraf ka rabta hai: shehar A se B ki sarak ho to zaroori nahi ke B se A wapsi ki sarak bhi ho. Undirected edge dono taraf ka rabta hai.

blocks.prompt: Undirected graph jis ki edges A-B, A-E, B-E, B-D, B-C, C-D aur E-D hain (Figure 4.12), us mein har vertex ki degree kya hai?
blocks.explanation: A 2, B 4, C 2, D 3, E 3. Degrees ka jama 14 hai, jo 7 edges ka dugna hai.

items: Graph ki tafseelat: degree, weight, direction.
